RacketConnect project hub

One free map of every racket sport, from park courts to private clubs. Pick the door that fits you.

  • Use it
  • See how it's built
  • Run it
  • All docs and tools

1. Use it

For players. Nothing to install, no sign-in.

  • Open the live map: find a court, an event to watch or a group to play with.
  • Ask a question: the map's Ask box answers plain-English questions about places and the data (counts, rankings, how sure the names are).
  • Something wrong or missing? Use "Fix or add your listing" in the map's About card, or see how to contribute.

2. See how it's built

For reviewers and hiring managers: the whole story in about five minutes.

  1. How it's built: the pipeline, its checks and live numbers.
  2. Case study: the problem, trade-offs, incidents and results.
  3. Architecture: the layers and how data flows, in one diagram.
  4. Data quality dashboard: freshness, coverage and service levels, live.
  5. Decision records: one short record per design decision.

3. Run it

For whoever maintains the project.

  • All docs and tools, below: every runbook, monitor, plan and research note.
  • Project README: quick start. Editing the data: data guide. Then the twice-monthly refresh.
  • Status: what is being worked on now.

All docs and tools

Every doc, runbook, monitor and tool, grouped by purpose, with a search box. Docs open on GitHub; each question has one home here, other pages link instead of repeating it.

Live pages

Map, project hub, how it's built, run history, database docs and lineage (dbt docs, built from sample data), and for builders and AI tools the data dictionary and llms.txt.

Understand it

  • Source repository and ../README.md: what it is, quick start, how to edit the data. Reports and PRs: ../CONTRIBUTING.md.
  • case_study.md: the problem, trade-offs and incidents.
  • Decision records (ADRs 0001-0041).
  • architecture.md (with architecture.svg): layers and flow.
  • tools_and_strategies.md: tools, sources, governance, ML, CI. The tool dictionary (every tool, lifecycle, license) is a private Google Sheet (owner); update its row and this file's in the same task whenever a tool, library, service or data source is added or removed.
  • data_guide.md: sources, seeds and how to edit them.
  • scale.md: what the extracts read of Overture, and how build time grows with data.
  • running_costs.md: hosting, data, CI and the capped AI agents.
  • talk_outline.md, articles/: walkthrough outline and write-ups.

Data quality and monitoring

  • Live: the dashboard and run history. Site up? UptimeRobot monitors (owner email alerts), decisions/0037-uptime-monitoring.md.
  • data_quality.md: scorecard and SLAs. coverage_snapshot.md: generated by make report.
  • data_observability.md: Elementary pipeline health. ops_metrics.md: delivery and workflow metrics. agent_activity.md: live agent activity page. looker_studio.md: second BI view.
  • gold_set_plan.md: the Overture/OSM match gold set. osm_fix_list.md, contribute_to_osm.md: fixing OpenStreetMap.
  • Usage: GoatCounter (owner login), goat_analysis.md.

Run it (runbooks)

  • monthly_refresh.md: the twice-monthly refresh.
  • merge_conflicts.md: how the repo avoids PR merge conflicts (venues.json layout and merge driver, union merges, rerere).
  • working_practices.md, commands.md, token_efficiency.md: build and ship practices, every make target, and the hooks that keep sessions cheap (moved out of CLAUDE.md).
  • cloud_routines.md: the scheduled cloud routines and their ids; run at claude.ai/code/routines (owner login).
  • tournament_run_parts.md (the five parts), tournament_refresh.md (tournament steps), tournament_sources.md (source list and the table tennis/badminton pass), event_group_search.md (events, leagues, groups per state).
  • refresh_agent.md, merge_gate_threat_model.md: the agent and its merge gate (ADR 0019). The weekly audit digest and the Dependabot config are described in the threat model and SECURITY.md (reporting a vulnerability, scope, what is in place).
  • new_region_checklist.md, fork_guide.md: new regions and forks.
  • Session notes from the automated routines only: sessions/.

Plans, market notes and research scans

  • Dated plans, market and competitor notes, beta feedback and one-off research passes live in the docs folder; status.md has what is current. The CSV and JSON files there are script outputs: do not hand-edit them.

ML and AI

  • ml.md: strategy, plan and discovery in one file.
